prompt: A synthetic traveler requires both ingredient exclusion and no shared equipment. Each fact applies to the specific meal service. For every ingredient/equipment boolean, true means the stated exclusion requirement is satisfied, false means it is not satisfied, and null means unconfirmed. Select exactly two qualifying options from restaurant-a, restaurant-b and restaurant-c for a normal meal and fallback. If fewer than two qualify, selection must be [] to defer normal-meal completion; do not invent an exception or claim a single option completes it. Pending lists unknown ingredient/equipment facts. Other identity, opening, route and meal-window fit prerequisites are assumed satisfied; this case checks only the listed dietary conditions and independent fallback evidence. Calculation merely repeats the supplied meal window length in minutes. This is synthetic evidence reasoning, not medical advice.

a-ingredients.description: Synthetic: restaurant a required ingredient exclusion is satisfied for specified service

a-equipment.description: Synthetic: restaurant a required no-shared-equipment condition is satisfied for specified service

b-ingredients.description: Synthetic: restaurant b required ingredient exclusion is satisfied for specified service

b-equipment.description: Synthetic: restaurant b required no-shared-equipment condition is satisfied for specified service

c-ingredients.description: Synthetic: restaurant c required ingredient exclusion is satisfied for specified service

c-equipment.description: Synthetic: restaurant c required no-shared-equipment condition is satisfied for specified service
